mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recommendation_histories (user_id, food_id, emotion_id, category_id, advice_text, is_favorite, is_public) VALUES (#{userId}, #{foodId}, #{emotionId}, #{categoryId}, #{adviceText}, #{isFavorite}, #{isPublic})
mapper.select:
SELECT h.id AS h_id, h.user_id AS h_user_id, h.food_id AS h_food_id, h.emotion_id AS h_emotion_id, h.category_id AS h_category_id, h.advice_text AS h_advice_text, h.is_favorite AS h_is_favorite, h.is_public AS h_is_public, h.created_at AS h_created_at,
f.id AS f_id, f.name AS f_name, f.emotion_id AS f_emotion_id, f.category_id AS f_category_id, f.description AS f_description, f.advice_type AS f_advice_type, f.image_keyword AS f_image_keyword, f.image_url AS f_image_url, f.effect AS f_effect, f.rarity AS f_rarity, f.is_active AS f_is_active,
e.id AS e_id, e.name AS e_name, e.label AS e_label, e.emoji AS e_emoji, e.color_code AS e_color_code, c.id AS c_id, c.name AS c_name, c.label AS c_label, c.icon AS c_icon
FROM recommendation_histories h INNER JOIN foods f ON h.food_id = f.id INNER JOIN emotions e ON h.emotion_id = e.id INNER JOIN food_categories c ON h.category_id = c.id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC

FROM recommendation_histories h INNER JOIN foods f ON h.food_id = f.id INNER JOIN emotions e ON h.emotion_id = e.id INNER JOIN food_categories c ON h.category_id = c.id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} AND h.is_favorite = #{isFavorite} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC
